records.name: EOS Master Roadmap
records.vision: Build EOS into the executive operating system for AI-native enterprises and Digital Twin Assets.
records.mission: Coordinate engineering, research, commercialization, and investor readiness through a live authoritative roadmap.
strategicObjectives: Reach Alpha with reliable engineering automation and Mission Control visibility.
Create the Digital Twin Asset platform foundation.
Develop Second Balance Sheet research and investor materials.
Prepare EOS for commercial launch readiness.

programs.name: Engineering Foundation
programs.businessImpact: Creates a reliable development and release foundation for EOS.
programs.businessPlanAlignment: Establishes reliable platform infrastructure for the AI-native enterprise operating system.
programs.investorRelevance: Shows engineering maturity, durability, and repeatable delivery discipline.
programs.secondBalanceSheetImpact: Creates durable operating records that can become valuation evidence.

risks.title: Mission Control actions are visible but not executable.
Roadmap scope can exceed engineering capacity.
risks.mitigation: Use PMO prioritization and dependency governance.

risks.title: Internal valuation estimates could be misread as audited financial valuation.
risks.mitigation: Keep valuation clearly marked as internal estimate only until governance, audit, and financial review are complete.

records.businessValue: Creates strategic delivery governance and a single source of truth for EOS execution.
records.researchValue: Connects research tracks, publications, and IP themes to concrete platform delivery.
records.investorValue: Provides executives and investors with a transparent roadmap, milestones, risks, and progress.

currentSprint.name: Platform Audit & Capability Readiness Center
currentSprint.focus: Audit functional readiness, classify capability maturity, identify placeholders and technical debt, and prioritize the next strategic build program.

records.recommendedAction: Review Platform Audit readiness and approve the Enterprise Data Ingestion & Governed Execution Foundation as the next strategic program.

liveStatus.summary: Master Roadmap is tracking identity media, startup experience, organization intake, enterprise digital twin visualization, investment thesis alignment, strategy, Mission Control experience, platform operations, AI workforce operations, persistence, and capability dependencies.
